messages:
maya: heads up — apiserver 503s in asia-northeast1 started ~10:04 UTC. control-plane CPU spikes + etcd compaction stalls. seeing a bunch of GPU attach failures for new pods. tagging @rob :thinking:
rob: looking — controller-manager leader-election churning in logs, plus apiserver timeout to etcd. quick paste of recent lines:
```
ControllerManager: ERROR: failed to acquire leader: context deadline exceeded
apiserver: 503 GET /api/v1/nodes (storage timeout)
etcd: compact delta exceeded; compaction loop paused for 2.1s; wal flush backlog
kubelet: attach/detach controller timed out for pvc xxxxx
```
jess: did we change compaction schedule/config recently? I remember a PR touching the compactor daemon last week. could be more aggressive retention/delta.
alex: that was me — I rolled a compactor tune yesterday to reduce disk retention (delta=100) to save space. might be too aggressive for the IO profile. rolling back now.
rob: mitigation plan in flight: 1) pause external compactor job (systemd) in ne1 control-plane hosts 2) recycle controller-manager in ne1-a to stop election churn 3) move new GPU attach work to other regions until healthy.
maya: commands i ran: `kubectl -n kube-system delete pod controller-manager-asia-ne1-a-0` (recreated and stabilized leader), also bumped apiserver timeouts temporarily.
alex: paused compactor service on etcd voters with `sudo systemctl stop etcd-compactor` on ne1-etcd-0/1/2 — monitoring IO. revert PR #324 in infra-config.
sre-oncall-bot: incident INC-20263 created by maya: "asia-ne1 apiserver 503s, etcd compaction stall, GPU attach failures". page: oncall@sre.
rob: observed GPU attach errors from cloud provider: `AttachVolume timeout` and `Attach failed: rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded`. attaching was queuing and timing out because control plane retries were increasing.
eli: cost note — we spilled some jobs to Dedicated burst GPUs and cross-region fallbacks. rough extra cost estimate so far: $1.7k. will refine after postmortem.
jess: action items: (A) revert compaction tuning + add safer defaults (B) add alert for "etcd compaction stall > 1s" (C) IO QoS for etcd hosts (D) scheduler guard to delay heavy GPU attach churn during compactor windows.
alex: also adding a short cooldown in our GPU provisioner — if attach error rate > 5% for 5m, move new scheduling to a fallback pool. PR incoming.
maya: timeline for incident (short form):
- 10:04 UTC: first 503s and GPU attach failures observed
- 10:06 UTC: controller-manager leader election churn detected
- 10:09 UTC: compactor config identified as recent change (rolled by alex)
- 10:12 UTC: compactor paused, controller-manager recycled
- 10:20 UTC: apiserver stabilized, GPU attach success rate rising
- 10:35 UTC: incident declared resolved, monitoring for regressions

rob: follow-up notes: need a runbook entry for "compactor-induced control-plane IO pressure" and an automated safeguard to pause compaction when etcd WAL backlog > X.
jess: assigning owners: jess -> compactor revert + alert, rob -> runbook + IO QoS, alex -> provisioner cooldown PR, maya -> write postmortem and timeline.
eli: will include cost impact in postmortem and flag to finance lead.
maya: thanks all. will ping when postmortem draft is up. :thumbsup:
